C0798.title: Microsoft Exposes Storm-2949 Using Stolen Credentials for Large-Scale Cloud Resource Theft
C0798.summary: Microsoft's security team disclosed that the threat actor group Storm-2949, by stealing legitimate user credentials without deploying malware, progressively escalated from identity compromise to large-scale data exfiltration and resource abuse across cloud environments.
